versions.content: Definition of configurable interface <ComUser_ComCbkTx Confirmation> Status: DRAFT Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02044, SRS_Com_02114 Previous identifiers: SWS_LDCOM_91008 Service Name <ComUser_ComCbkTxConfirmation> (draft) Syntax void <ComUser_ComCbkTxConfirmation> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, Std_ReturnType result ) Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same ComUserCbkHandleId, otherwise Reentrant ComUserCbkHandleId Com user callback handle Id corresponding to the PDU that has been transmitted Parameters (in) result E_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of the PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description The lower layer communication interface module confirms the transmission of a PDU, or the failure to transmit a PDU.
